text: Why did the skeleton stay at home? He had no body to go with!
instructions: Speak with a natural British English accent as a warm, friendly, playful pumpkin telling a joke to young children. Sound like an expressive storyteller, relaxed and conversational, never robotic, menacing or startling. Use a little amused warmth in the punchline and a brief natural pause after the question. Read only the supplied words. Do not add an introduction, sound effects or laughter.
